notes: One verse writes both article behaviours: τοῖς χείλεσιν takes the supplied their under rule 20's second arm with the case preposition with riding along under rule 21, while ἡ before καρδία is emptied by the expressed αὐτῶν.
ὅτι is recitative under rule 43, the ASV marking the Isaiah quotation by punctuation alone.
πόρρω keeps far and ἀπέχει keeps the copular is; splitting them under rule 2 was preferred to giving is far whole to the verb.
